data.description: Al Safa Dubai: Where Modern Comforts Meet Timeless Charm

data.answer:
The community offers a convenient lifestyle to its residents, with many attractions, schools, supermarkets, and medical centers all conveniently located within the vicinity.  The Dubai Water Canal winding through the neighborhood presents a picturesque skyline and waterfront views. With diverse residential choices and numerous amenities in proximity, Al Safa provides a comfortable living environment suitable for families, expatriates, and students alike.

Close by stands the Al Farooq Omar bin Khattab Mosque, affectionately referred to as Dubai's Blue Mosque, drawing inspiration from Turkey's renowned 17th-century Sultan Ahmed Mosque, a quintessential example of Ottoman architecture. Visitors are invited to explore its interior, adorned with thousands of vibrant Turkish Iznik tiles showcasing intricate craftsmanship.

Residential areas within Al Safa exhibit contemporary architectural styles influenced by Islamic and European designs. Al Safa is renowned primarily for its independent villas and those situated within compounds. Villas range from a minimum of 3 bedrooms to expansive mansions boasting 11 or more bedrooms. Popular Al Safa villa configurations in Al Safa encompass 3, 4, 5, and 6-bedroom layouts.

Similarly, the townhouses and apartments in the neighborhood, mirroring the community's ethos, boast spacious layouts and shared facilities. Both Al Safa 1 and Al Safa 2 feature villa compounds. Noteworthy Al Safa 1 villa compounds include Splendour Villas Al Safa 1, Wasl Square, and Al Hala Complex.

Situated at the heart of Al Safa 1, Splendour Villas comprises 90 homes offering duplex 4-bedroom residences. Each unit boasts a private pool and landscaped gardens. Another sought-after compound in Al Safa 1 is Wasl Square, featuring 174 townhouses available in 3 and 4-bedroom configurations. Al Hala Complex, a smaller enclave, consists of only 16 villas, each with a private pool. Residents have access to a community center and gym in the compound's northern part.

Among Al Safa 2 villas are Bayti 22 and Al Wasl Village. Bayti 22 encompasses 22 villas, all featuring 4 bedrooms, a maid’s room, a laundry room, and a private garden. Al Wasl Village comprises 26 semi-detached 4-bedroom houses, each equipped with a private pool, garden, terrace, barbecue area, laundry room, and maid’s room. Notably, Al Wasl Village is pet-friendly.

Properties for Rent in Al Safa 

Are you looking for properties for rent in Al Safa? Rent for 4-bedroom villas in Al Safa starts from AED 250k per year. Those seeking more expansive accommodations can choose 5-bedroom villas available for rent in Al Safa, starting from AED 400k annually. For larger families or those desiring extra space, spacious 6-bedroom villas in Al Safa are priced at AED 420k per year. You can compare the rental prices with other properties for rent in Dubai.

Properties for Sale in Al Safa

Looking for properties for sale in Dubai? The expansive villas in the Al Safa area are an excellent option. In Al Safa, a 5-bedroom villa is available at prices starting from AED 11M. Similarly, the sales price for a 6-bedroom villa in Al Safa starts from AED 11M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Safa?

data.answer:
Residents enjoy modern amenities amidst a backdrop of lush greenery and serene surroundings in the Al Safa area. From luxurious villas to upscale apartment complexes, Al Safa offers a diverse range of housing options. You can also find well-maintained parks, recreational & leisure facilities, and schools in the area. All in all, Al Safa is the perfect balance between convenience and tranquility in the heart of Dubai.

Public Transportation in Al Safa

Residents of Al Safa Villas Dubai find managing their commute or accessing transportation options convenient. Onpassive Metro Station is merely 5 minutes away from the community's midpoint. Business Bay Metro Station is slightly farther, taking about 6 to 10 minutes to reach, depending on one's location within Al Safa.

Furthermore, Al Safa 1 and the surrounding neighborhood of Al Safa 2 feature multiple bus stops, facilitating connections to major landmarks in Dubai and linking back to the metro stations. Additionally, several bus stations are situated in the neighboring areas of Umm Suqeim and Jumeirah.

Supermarkets in Al Safa

Al Safa hosts several renowned supermarkets including Carrefour Market, Spinneys Umm Suqeim, and Choithrams. In addition to these major chains, numerous smaller grocery stores cater to the diverse needs of residents.

The popular 'Park and Shop' supermarket is situated within Al Safa Centre in Al Safa 1. Located on the corner of Al Wasl Road, this supermarket is favored among the expatriate community for its pork section, which is segregated from the rest of the supermarket and reserved for non-Muslim customers.

Shopping Malls Near Al Safa

Situated along Sheikh Zayed Road, Oasis Mall is only a short drive from the community. With approximately 70 stores, the mall offers a diverse shopping experience. Amsaf Mall is also very close to the Al Safa community.

For avid shoppers, Al Safa offers an ideal residential locale with two of the emirate's major malls, Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates, located approximately 10 to 15 minutes away, depending on your proximity.

Additionally, the area features a variety of niche stores catering to specific interests, such as the Barracuda Fishing and Outdoors for fishing enthusiasts, Bookworm for bibliophiles, and PetsPlus LLC for pet owners. Addressing lifestyle needs, stores like Thread Up Tailoring and Boutique, United Furniture, and Trek Bicycle Store, among others, are conveniently located close to Al Safa.

Schools Near Al Safa

Parents in Al Safa have a plethora of esteemed schooling options for their children, benefitting from the proximity to some of Dubai's finest schools in Jumeirah. Al Safa 1 hosts three schools rated as 'outstanding' by the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA) – Jumeirah Primary School and Jumeirah English Speaking School (JESS), both offering the British curriculum from FS1 to Year 6. Subsequently, students can transition to Jumeirah College for Years 7 to 13, with all three institutions conveniently situated within walking distance of each other.

Moreover, Emirates English Speaking School, Al Ittihad Private School, and Al Anwar Kindergarten School further enrich the educational landscape of the area.

Regarding higher education opportunities, The English College is conveniently located within a short drive from the area. Moreover, numerous colleges and specialized educational institutions are situated close by, such as the Professional & Accountancy Centre, The College of Fashion & Design, and the Toni Malt Makeup Academy. Additionally, internationally accredited universities within Knowledge Village, near Media City, are reachable within a 20-minute drive.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Al Safa Area 

Dubai is renowned for its many splendid mosques, and Al Safa is no exception, boasting a significant number within the vicinity, thus facilitating easy access for the Muslim community. Al Farooq Omar Bin Al Khattab Mosque and Ayesha Mosque are prominent examples within the area. Additionally, residents have the convenience of visiting mosques in neighboring communities due to the short distances involved.

For members of the Christian community, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints is situated in Al Safa 1. Meanwhile, Hindu and Sikh residents can easily access Mahamevnawa Buddhist Temple, Baba Temple, and Gurdwara Temple due to their proximity.

Clinics and Hospitals in Al Safa Dubai

When it comes to healthcare, the Al Safa community ensures its residents have access to top-notch services, with some of Dubai's finest hospitals situated nearby. Medcare Hospital, renowned for its quality care, is conveniently located within the community. Additionally, other medical facilities like Medcare Orthopaedics & Spine Hospital, Medcare Women & Children Hospital, and Wooridul Spine Centre are also situated within the community, offering residents specialized care right at their doorstep.

Al Safa Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Al Safa boasts an advantageous geographical position, bordering many lively communities. Al Safa is connected by Jumeirah to the north, Al Quoz to the south, Al Wasl to the east, and Al Manara to the west. Similarly, Al Wasl Road (D 92) is to the northwest and Sheikh Zayed Road (E 11) is to the southwest of Al Safa.

Moreover, the emirate's coastal strip and Downtown Dubai are accessible within 5 to 12 minutes, offering residents diverse entertainment options.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Safa

data.answer:
There is so much to do in Al Safa, from walking in Safa Park to enjoying beautiful views of the Dubai Water Canal. The area is close to iconic communities, offering its residents tons of leisure facilities.

Restaurants In and Near Al Safa Dubai

Al Safa boasts a diverse dining culture with a range of eateries to suit every palate. From fine-dining restaurants to popular fast-food chains, options abound in the area, including China Garden Dubai Al Safa, Chez Sushi, Pizza Express, Hadoota Masreya, and Reem Al Bawadi.

China Garden Dubai Al Safa is an excellent option if you want to indulge in Chinese delicacies. In addition to independent outlets, residents can explore dining establishments in malls, hotels, and beaches in and around the town. Enhancing the dining experience, Downtown Dubai's Souk Al Bahar offers waterfront dining, while Kite Beach, merely 5 to 10 minutes away, provides a wide array of beachside dining options.

Beaches Near Al Safa 

Due to its proximity to the Dubai coastline, Al Safa residents enjoy convenient access to several beaches. Among them, Kite Beach, Jumeirah Beach, and Sunset Beach stand out for their minimal commute time, typically just 7 to 8 minutes away, depending on one's location.

Renowned for its watersports, dining options, and shopping facilities, Kite Beach holds a special place as one of Dubai's most popular beaches. Given its proximity to Al Safa, many residents in the community frequent this beach for thrilling adventures and leisurely outings.

Hotels in Al Safa Dubai

Holiday Inn Express Dubai Safa Park, an IHG Hotel, is a popular hotel in the area. This Al Safa Hotel Dubai is 10 minutes away from Dubai Mall. It offers luxury guest rooms equipped with TVs, fridges, and other amenities. The iconic Burj Al Arab Hotel is also located nearby. The seven-star hotel is a popular landmark of the city. Roda Beach Resort Dubai is also located close to the Al Safa area. This super luxury hotel in Jumeirah offers studio apartments, 1-bedroom apartments, 3-bedroom apartments, and the Grand deluxe 5-bedroom Villa. Al Habtoor Tower and La Perle are also located nearby.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Al Safa

Another notable feature of Al Safa is the Dubai Water Canal, a recent milestone in Dubai's development. Stretching 3.2 kilometers, this waterway winds its way through Business Bay before flowing into Jumeirah. Beyond its impressive visuals, the canal project incorporates running tracks, a mechanical waterfall, and public spaces for visitors to relish and appreciate the scenic vistas. Oli Oli, a very popular kids' attraction, is in the community. 3D World Selfie Museum Dubai is also located close to the area.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Fitness enthusiasts relocating to Al Safa need not fret, as numerous fitness centers dot the vicinity. While neighboring communities may offer additional options, residents will find these facilities conveniently located within a short distance, thanks to the area's proximity and accessible routes.

Furthermore, the community boasts an array of salons and spas catering to beauty and relaxation needs. Among them, Spaces Beauty Salon and Spa, Sasha Beauty Salon, and Casa Havana Beauty Salon are just a few minutes' journey from the heart of the community.

While Al Safa offers many advantages, there are also some drawbacks to consider. Being centrally located, Al Safa can experience heavy traffic congestion, especially during peak hours, which can make commuting challenging.

What is the Al Safa location?

To reach Al Safa, hop off at the Business Bay station on the Dubai Metro and follow the pedestrian path on the Sheikh Zayed Road bridge, where an elevator awaits to transport you to the Dubai Water Canal. Alternatively, RTA ferries make a stop at the Sheikh Zayed Road marine station, while water taxis offer access from various stations in Business Bay, Al Wasl, and Safa Park.

What are the housing options like in Al Safa?

Al Safa offers a mix of housing options including villas, townhouses, and apartments. The majority of residential units are villas, with some compounds available as well.

What are the nearby amenities and facilities in Al Safa?

Al Safa residents have access to various amenities such as supermarkets, medical centers, schools, and parks. Additionally, there are shopping malls and dining options within proximity.

How is the transportation connectivity in Al Safa?

Al Safa is well-connected by road, with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, making commuting convenient. Public transportation options include bus stops and metro stations like Noor Bank Metro Station.

Are there recreational activities available in Al Safa?

Yes, Al Safa offers recreational activities such as Safa Park, which has jogging tracks, play areas, and barbecue pits. Residents can also enjoy nearby beaches like Kite Beach and Jumeirah Beach.

What are the schools and educational facilities like in Al Safa?

Al Safa is home to several schools catering to different curriculums, including British and international schools. Additionally, there are educational institutions nearby in neighboring communities.

Is it possible to have a barbecue at Safa Park?

Yes. You can plan a picnic in Safa Park, utilizing the permanent barbecue stations around its perimeter.

data.content:
Al Safa is a family-friendly community located in the Jumeirah area along Al Wasl Road. It offers a vibrant living experience and is divided into two sub-districts: Al Safa 1 and Al Safa 2.

You can find a selection of luxury villas, low-rise buildings, and royal residences in the district. The area has undergone remarkable transformation in recent years, particularly after the inauguration of the Dubai Water Canal in 2016.

Safa Park, one of the city's oldest that has gone through a major transformation, is cherished by residents for its lush scenery and extensive play areas for children. The area's proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road makes it easy for residents to commute. It is also well-connected to public transportation. Moreover, Al Safa offers various attractions and facilities to residents.

nodes.about:
Welcome to Safa Gate, an exciting new project by DAMAC Properties in Safa Park, Dubai. Offering 1 & 2-bedroom apartments, along with 3 & 5-bedroom penthouses featuring private pools, Safa Gate combines luxury living with breathtaking views. Located in the heart of the Al Safa area, Safa Gate apartments provide seamless connections to major attractions. This remarkable real estate development redefines elegance with innovative architecture and a harmonious blend of natural elements.

Designed to cater to modern luxury living, Safa Gate boasts an array of world-class amenities, including a rooftop observation deck, infinity pools, an outdoor gym, a Gravity Gym, a yoga deck, and a private Eclipse Cinema. Residents can also enjoy an elegant cigar lounge, co-working pods, and multiple relaxation areas, creating an exclusive sanctuary in the heart of Dubai. With an attractive payment plan featuring 1% monthly installments over 48 months, owning a home in this prestigious development is now more accessible.
